application.client_navigation: React Router compatibility layer inside the single Next.js browser shell

runtime_boundaries.browser: UI, client navigation, and Supabase Auth/session only; all operational Supabase REST, RPC, Function, and Storage HTTP traffic must traverse app/api/**
runtime_boundaries.server: app/api/** is the canonical operational data boundary for authorization, Supabase data/function/storage traffic, provider calls, webhooks, idempotency, background workers and audit-sensitive operations
runtime_boundaries.database: canonical business state, workspace tenancy, RLS, transactional RPCs and durable outboxes

provider_ownership.transactional_email_fallback: Enginemailer only after Resend rejects/fails before acceptance
provider_ownership.vehicle_catalog: server-routed Supabase Edge Function for intentionally public catalog reads

forbidden_competing_architecture: Vite production runtime or Vite deployment
Express adapter as a second production authority
VITE_* environment variables in runtime code
direct privileged provider calls from browser code
direct operational Supabase HTTP calls from browser code
